text: When his term was complete, Musa set out with his family, back toward Egypt.
It was a cold, dark night in the desert. Then, on the side of the mountain, he saw a fire.
He told his family: stay here. Perhaps I can bring you some news, or a burning stick, so you can warm yourselves.
But when he came to it, he was called: "Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa."
"Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me, and establish prayer for My remembrance."
Then Allah asked: "And what is that in your right hand, O Musa?" He said: it is my staff. I lean on it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep.
"Throw it down, O Musa." So he threw it down... and it was a snake, moving swiftly.
"Seize it, and fear not. We will return it to its former state."
And then came the command: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
